# TaskForce

> TaskForce is a free, open source desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux) to plan your projects and hand tasks to AI coding agents such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot, while you keep the final say.

You write your issues and keep your project notes (Brain OS) in TaskForce. When an issue is ready, you assign it to an agent. The agent reads the issue and the related notes, works on its own branch, asks before any action outside its limits, and comes back with a pull request, or a comment when there is no code. Nothing is merged without you.

TaskForce has no account and no server: your data stays in a folder on your computer, and the app sends no usage data. The AI can run on a local model through Ollama, or on any OpenAI-compatible API key you choose. Without AI, the project management features keep working. The app is made for one person: there is no sync between computers.

## Pages
- [Home](https://taskforce-project.fr/): What TaskForce does, in one page.
- [Features](https://taskforce-project.fr/features): Planning (board, list, backlog, cycles, roadmap), Brain OS memory, agents, the assistant, analytics and connections.
- [Agents](https://taskforce-project.fr/agents): How a run works with Claude Code or GitHub Copilot, what an agent can touch, and what each one needs.
- [Security](https://taskforce-project.fr/security): Where the data lives, what can leave the computer and when, and how to report a vulnerability.
- [Download](https://taskforce-project.fr/download): The current release, system requirements, AI options and release notes.
- [Moving from the web app](https://taskforce-project.fr/migrate): How to export projects from the hosted web app, which is closing, and import them into the desktop app.
